name: E-Commerce Platform
description: Multi-service online store platform featuring product catalog frontend, Go REST API for orders & cart, AI recommendation worker, PostgreSQL database, and Valkey cache.

services.name: webapp
services.description: Node.js Frontend presenting product catalog, shopping cart & checkout UI

services.name: apigateway
services.description: Go REST API handling product inventory, cart management & order placement

services.name: aiworker
services.description: Python recommendation worker calculating product similarity & personalized suggestions

services.name: dbpostgres
services.description: PostgreSQL database storing catalog products, user accounts & order history

services.name: cachevalkey
services.description: Valkey in-memory cache for fast cart storage & session management
